name: browser-access
description: Checks what a browser page can reach on Signal's infrastructure.

scripts.build: npm run generate && npm run build:wasm && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=public/main.js && cp src/wasm/signal_migration_wasm_bg.wasm public/
scripts.check: npm run generate && npm run build:wasm && tsc --noEmit
